outcome: hematological parameters in mothers with preeclampsia and umbilical cord blood
correlations between preeclamptic mothers and their newborn in Hb, PCV, MCV, MCHC, RBC and retics
cohort: 80 preecalmptic mothers and eighty normal pregnant mothers
finding: Changes in several hematological parameters associated with preeclampsia were correlated in affected mothers and their newborns.
